sourceNotes: The u rows are u(0.5;y), so coordinate is y; the v rows are v(x;0.5), so coordinate is x.
Table 6 states that non-coordinate variables use extrapolations through Eq. (12) from the 1024x1024 grid; these values are therefore Richardson-extrapolated estimates, not raw 1024-grid samples.
Table 7 U is the authors' estimated discretization error from Eqs. (13) or (14). It is recorded as published and is not treated here as a rigorous confidence interval or acceptance tolerance.
data.citation: C. H. Marchi, R. Suero and L. K. Araki, The Lid-Driven Square Cavity Flow: Numerical Solution with a 1024 x 1024 Grid (2009)
data.transcriptionVerification: All 30 values and 30 error estimates checked against rendered Tables 6/7 and an independent extraction of the PDF text.

limitations: Only steady Re100 unit-square cavity and centreline velocity; not arbitrary geometry/turbulence/wall-force certification.
Published errors are authors discretization estimates; not guaranteed confidence bounds.
Legacy Ghia trend is preserved false, and complete audit exits 1. Different point sets belong to different references; do not compare RMSE magnitudes as though points were identical.
No new OpenFOAM, actual GUI, or Windows/Linux validation; product binary is unchanged.
Pressure multigrid does not remove slow SIMPLE outer convergence; fourth mesh required 8590 outer iterations.
plotLineScope: Lines join sampled centreline values and exact wall endpoints; no extra near-wall samples are implied
